headline: EOG Q2 Earnings Call Highlights UAE Progress & Cost Discipline

headline: Truist Securities Maintains Hold on EOG Resources, Raises Price Target to $153
summary: Truist Securities  analyst Gabe Daoud   maintains EOG Resources (NYSE:EOG) with a Hold and raises the price target from $134 to $153.
